direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; interactive targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for the stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text as the owner-required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular alignment for quantities, time and cost
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo at left and Lock recovery room at right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; StepRail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge the Certificate and Receiving value area so 120 and 80 render fully without clipping against the tracks, keeping DOES NOT MATCH aligned to the numeric gap.
Refit the inspector top so MATERIAL HOLD heading is not cut off at 1366x768; start its internal scroll region below the panel title.
Raise silverDim body contrast on evidence rows and add a focus ring to each selectable evidence item linked to its SVG track.
Keep ROUTE HEALTH · PRE-FLIGHT and INVESTIGATION · SOURCE EVIDENCE as separate labelled groups with independent status text; do not merge their controls or completion state.
Enlarge the route select to a 40px target and show the chosen route, nonce state and identity state as three distinct pre-flight rows before Run Sample investigation.
Remove the clipped 12 and 80 truncation in the SVG labels by widening the label column and right-aligning tabular quantities.
Preserve the flow where selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form in place; keep Accept disabled until the exact phrase matches and announce the match state via aria-live.
Reduce vertical crowding in option cards so finish and incremental cost stay on one tabular baseline at 360px width.
Give the typed phrase input a visible label, character count tied to the required phrase, and a 2px focus ring with offset.
Keep the three proposed tasks explicitly marked PROPOSED · UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL and outside any tracked count until Approve is pressed.
Make the task list scroll cue clearer with a bottom fade and End of proposal marker reachable by keyboard, without shrinking the 36px Decline target.
Enlarge the MAT-ALLOY-B · 70 parts flow label so it does not overlap the 40 via CELL-MILL-1 route label.
Strengthen the preview state for CELL-MILL-2 with dashed silver outline plus PREVIEW · WILL GO OFFLINE text, reserving solid red only for the applied stopped state.
Place the invalidation warning adjacent to the machine select as well as in the DecisionBar so the consequence is read before Apply second shock receives focus.
Dim the disabled scenario management control further and add explanatory text that it is unavailable in this guided step.
Preserve red exclusively on CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; keep all other machines and routes silver or neon.
Separate pre-flight route-health status from the not-run investigation status with distinct headings and do not let Reinvestigate imply route health passed.
Widen the changed-capacity chip so Split available capacity and CONSTRAINED text do not collide with neighbouring option cards.
Fix overlapping text in the first two option cards where titles collide with Select this path and Selected path controls; increase card height within the inspector scroll area.
Keep the constrained Split path visually infeasible with pattern and text, never neon, and exclude it from keyboard selection.
Keep the revised typed consent form visible after selection, with prior acceptance invalidated stated once above the input and Accept disabled until exact match.
Preserve coexistence of 3 BLOCKED prior tasks, the approved revised plan status, and 3 proposed replacement tasks untracked until approval, each in separate labelled groups.
Add pattern plus text to blocked prior rows so blocked meaning does not rely on colour or position alone.
Prevent the proposed task list from clipping t2 details; allow internal scroll with visible focus ring on each task row.
Sequence Verify ledger, passphrase sealing and independent checkpoint as numbered, separately disabled steps so checkpoint cannot be acted on before sealing is complete.
Enlarge the 70, 35h and 48h metrics with clearer labels tying 48h to the replenishment comparison rather than a saving claim.
Give Export independent checkpoint a distinct secondary style from the single neon primary Verify ledger in the DecisionBar.
Add a completion check marker and aria-current to Recovery story complete in the rail, matching the sealed packet status in the DecisionBar.
Keep complete states for ledger, packet and checkpoint as text plus check marker, not colour alone, and retain the red stopped state for CELL-MILL-2 in the final map.
Provide one restrained secondary action to review retained evidence, without adding another primary or another logo placement.
